title: Modalidad avanzada
description: Matices de necesidad, obligación, probabilidad y especulación: needn't have frente a didn't need to, be bound / likely / set to y otras formas de decir qué tan seguro estás.
objectives: Distinguir needn't have de didn't need to y otras formas de falta de necesidad
Expresar probabilidad con be bound to, be likely to y be set to
Graduar la especulación con may well, could easily, can't possibly y expresiones con chance
Expresar obligación, permiso y expectativas con be supposed to, had better y be required to

subtopics.title: Needn't have vs. didn't need to
subtopics.goal: Expresar que algo no era necesario y dejar claro si se hizo o no.
keyPoints: needn't have + participio: lo hiciste, pero no hacía falta: You needn't have brought a present (y lo trajiste).
didn't need to + verbo base: no hacía falta, y normalmente no se hizo: I didn't need to take a taxi, so I walked.
didn't need to también puede usarse cuando sí se hizo, si el contexto lo aclara; needn't have siempre implica que se hizo.
No lo confundas con shouldn't have: needn't have = era innecesario; shouldn't have = estuvo mal hacerlo.
needn't + verbo base para el presente es más británico y formal: You needn't wait. En inglés americano es más común You don't have to wait.

examples.target: You needn't have cooked so much; there were only four of us.
examples.es: No hacía falta que cocinaras tanto: éramos solo cuatro.

examples.target: The meeting was canceled, so I didn't need to prepare the presentation after all.
examples.es: Se canceló la reunión, así que al final no tuve que preparar la presentación.

examples.target: We needn't have hurried: the train was forty minutes late.
examples.es: No hacía falta que nos apuráramos: el tren vino con cuarenta minutos de demora.

commonMistakes.wrong: I needn't have gone to work, so I stayed in bed.
commonMistakes.right: I didn't need to go to work, so I stayed in bed.
commonMistakes.why: Si no lo hiciste, va didn't need to; needn't have implica que sí lo hiciste.
Needn't funciona como modal y va sin to. Need como verbo común sí lleva to: You don't need to worry.

subtopics.title: Be bound to, be likely to y be set to
subtopics.goal: Expresar distintos grados de probabilidad sobre el futuro.
keyPoints: be bound to / be sure to / be certain to = es casi seguro: It's bound to rain on the day of the wedding.
be likely to / be unlikely to = probable / poco probable: Prices are likely to rise again. También It's likely that...
be set to = está previsto o todo indica que va a pasar; muy usado en noticias: The company is set to announce record profits.
Escala aproximada: be bound to > be likely to > may / might > be unlikely to.
likely es adjetivo, así que va con be: He's likely to win (no He likely wins). En inglés americano también se usa will likely: He will likely win.

examples.target: With so many fans in town, the hotels are bound to be full.
examples.es: Con tantos hinchas en la ciudad, los hoteles van a estar llenos seguro.

examples.target: The new law is unlikely to come into force before next year.
examples.es: Es poco probable que la ley nueva entre en vigencia antes del año que viene.

examples.target: The festival is set to attract over a million visitors.
examples.es: Se espera que el festival atraiga a más de un millón de visitantes.

commonMistakes.why: Probable no admite persona + to: se dice likely to o It's probable that he'll win.
Be bound to va seguido del verbo base.

subtopics.title: Matices de la especulación
subtopics.goal: Graduar la certeza al especular sobre el presente, el pasado y el futuro.
keyPoints: may well / might well = es bastante probable: She may well be right. Para el pasado: might well have + participio.
could easily = es muy posible, podría pasar sin problema: That could easily happen to anyone.
can't possibly / couldn't possibly = es imposible: He can't possibly have finished already.
Expresiones con sustantivo: There's a good chance (that)..., The chances are (that)..., In all likelihood..., There's no way (that)... (informal).
Adverbios para graduar: definitely, almost certainly, probably, possibly, conceivably. Van después de will y antes de won't: She'll probably come. She probably won't come.

examples.target: Don't throw the box away; we may well need it later.
examples.es: No tires la caja: es muy posible que después la necesitemos.

examples.target: Chances are she's already heard the news.
examples.es: Lo más probable es que ya se haya enterado de la noticia.

examples.target: He can't possibly have written the whole report in one night.
examples.es: Es imposible que haya escrito todo el informe en una noche.

commonMistakes.wrong: Is possible that he comes later.
commonMistakes.right: It's possible that he'll come later.
commonMistakes.why: La oración necesita sujeto (It's possible), y después de that no hay subjuntivo como en español: va will o el presente según el caso. También podés decir He may come later.

commonMistakes.wrong: She might well to be right.
commonMistakes.why: Después de might well va el verbo base, sin to.

subtopics.title: Obligación, permiso y expectativas
subtopics.goal: Expresar obligación, permiso y expectativas con matices de registro.
keyPoints: be supposed to = se supone que, se espera que (una regla o un plan que muchas veces no se cumple): We were supposed to meet at six, but he never showed up.
had better + verbo base = más vale que; es una advertencia con consecuencia: You'd better leave now or you'll miss the bus.
be required to / be obliged to = obligación formal: Passengers are required to wear seatbelts.
be allowed to / be permitted to (formal) = permiso. Para un permiso puntual en el pasado se usa was allowed to, no could: I was allowed to leave early.
it's up to you = depende de vos; there's no point in + -ing = no tiene sentido: There's no point in arguing.

examples.target: You're not supposed to park here; it's a loading zone.
examples.es: Acá no se puede estacionar: es zona de carga y descarga.

examples.target: We'd better book a table; it gets really busy on Fridays.
examples.es: Mejor reservemos una mesa: los viernes se llena.

examples.target: All employees are required to complete the safety training.
examples.es: Todos los empleados tienen la obligación de hacer la capacitación de seguridad.

commonMistakes.why: Had better va seguido del verbo base sin to y, aunque tenga had, habla del presente o del futuro.
'Supongo que' es I suppose (that); be supposed to es 'se supone que' (una expectativa o una regla): He's supposed to be coming.

subtopics.title: Un reclamo formal
subtopics.goal: Leer y escribir un email formal de reclamo que mida con precisión obligaciones, expectativas y consecuencias.
keyPoints: Abrí con el motivo: I am writing to complain about... / to express my dissatisfaction with...
Contrastá lo que se suponía que tenía que pasar con lo que pasó: The order was supposed to arrive within 48 hours.
Usá needn't have y didn't need to para esfuerzos o gastos innecesarios: As it turned out, I needn't have taken the day off.
Medí las consecuencias con matices: This is bound to affect..., It is unlikely that..., Further delays could easily...
Cerrá con un pedido concreto y una fórmula formal: I would appreciate a full refund. I look forward to your prompt reply.

examples.target: The technician was supposed to arrive between 9 and 12, but nobody turned up.
examples.es: El técnico tenía que venir entre las 9 y las 12, pero no apareció nadie.

examples.target: As it turned out, I needn't have taken the day off work.
examples.es: Al final, no hacía falta que me tomara el día en el trabajo.

examples.target: Further delays are bound to cause serious problems for my business.
examples.es: Si hay más demoras, sin duda van a causar problemas serios en mi negocio.

commonMistakes.wrong: I would like to receive a compensation.
commonMistakes.right: I would like to receive compensation.
commonMistakes.why: Compensation es incontable en este sentido: no lleva a.

commonMistakes.right: I look forward to your reply.
commonMistakes.why: 'Espero su respuesta' traducido literal suena brusco, casi una exigencia; la fórmula formal es I look forward to your reply o to hearing from you.
